detection (G36Config.empty_day_delay_min; policies/g36.py G36Controller._empty_day). The simulator sends nobody on
weekends and US federal holidays (smart_control/utils/conversion_utils.py is_work_day), the score charges no comfort
with nobody in (setpoint_energy_carbon_regret.py: regret 0 when total occupancy is 0), but the schedule runs a weekday

holiday falls). On f2d_a12_g05: the day turns empty when nobody has come 60 or 120 min after the morning start.
Scenarios without an empty weekday must come out unchanged.
